title: Reading an unchanged cell
statement: Let $s$ be a set of integer addresses and let $m,m'$ be memories mapping integer addresses to $W$-bit words. If $m'$ agrees with $m$ outside $s$, if $a\notin s$, and if $m(a)=v$ for a $W$-bit word $v$, then $m'(a)=v$.
